as_told.title: Remote viewer describes the moksha target as a grid and cage around a planet

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, passes on what a remote viewer named Scott Turner told him. Remote viewing is the practice of trying to sense faraway places or hidden things with the mind alone. According to Jorjani, Turner's group aimed at "moksha", an old Indian word for the soul's release from the cycle of rebirth, and found a vast machine for draining energy from souls, built in our solar system at the end of a war that wrecked it. Turner himself describes the target only as a fence or grid around a place, and says nothing of a war. If true, it would mean what people call spiritual liberation is really a trap.
